answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. Each agent escrows 5 POA per slot, released per milestone. A jury re-checks slots; fake work burns the deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 500 POA; one honest agent pays 5 POA, so losses grow linearly and the honest share is never diluted. Burns are published in a public record, a knoll on open ground, each entry hard to counterfeit as an opal. That ends the fable of free fake identities.
